title: Crookes tube jump observed by Brown as a student

tellings.quote: And what he observed was that when a high voltage was applied to the Crookes tube, he noticed that the wire conducting the voltage jumped.

plain: As a student at Caltech in Pasadena in the 1920s, the inventor Townsend Brown is said to have seen the wire carrying high voltage into a Crookes tube, an early glass vacuum tube, jump when the power was applied. The journalist and author Nick Cook tells this in a documentary about Brown as the moment that started Brown's lifelong work on whether electricity could produce motion or lift, work that was later linked to UFO-like craft.
